facts: Parties: Foxley Capital LLP (Buyer), Pemberton Pharma plc (Seller); the Company is Ingleby Pharma plc.
This Agreement is dated 5 August 2026; Closing is scheduled for 13 November 2026 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.
Section 3.4 (Earn-out): the Earn-out Payment equals 2 times the amount by which FY2026 EBITDA exceeds $4,000,000, capped at $10,000,000.
Section 15.1: this Agreement is governed by English law and the courts of England have exclusive jurisdiction.

Clause 4.1: the Escrow Amount shall be released to the Seller on the date falling 12 months after the Closing Date, save to the extent of pending claims notified before that date. 'Business Day' means a day other than a Saturday or Sunday on which banks are open in London.
Clause 12: this escrow agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York and disputes shall be referred to arbitration in New York.
Management accounts show FY2026 EBITDA of $4,800,000; the Seller says the Earn-out Payment will therefore be $1,200,000.

Clause 14.2: either party may terminate this agreement on 30 days' notice if the other party undergoes a change of control without its prior written consent. The counterparty is Marlow Industries Ltd.
Disclosure against Warranty 6.3 (Material Contracts): no material contract contains a change of control provision. (No further disclosure.)
